command:
set -euo pipefail
original_tree="$(pwd)"
feature_tree="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/private-connectivity-043-source"
git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null worktree add --detach "$feature_tree" "$PC043_EXPECTED_REVISION"
cd "$feature_tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PC043_EXPECTED_REVISION" ]
echo "043 tested source: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
python3 -m pytest -q \
  specs/043-private-connectivity-production/tests/test_evidence.py \
  specs/043-private-connectivity-production/tests/test_evidence_pins.py \
  --junitxml="$RUNNER_TEMP/private-connectivity-043-source.xml"
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PC043_EXPECTED_REVISION" ]
python3 - <<'PY'
from collections import Counter
import os
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

expected = {
    "specs.043-private-connectivity-production.tests.test_evidence": 287,
    "specs.043-private-connectivity-production.tests.test_evidence_pins": 40,
}
report = ET.parse(Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "private-connectivity-043-source.xml").getroot()
cases = list(report.iter("testcase"))
actual = Counter(case.get("classname") for case in cases)
if dict(actual) != expected:
    raise SystemExit(f"043 source suite collection mismatch: {dict(actual)!r}; expected {expected!r}")
identities = [(case.get("classname"), case.get("name")) for case in cases]
if len(identities) != len(set(identities)):
    raise SystemExit("043 source report contains duplicate test identities")
for suite in report.iter("testsuite"):
    if any(int(suite.get(field, 0)) != 0 for field in ("failures", "errors", "skipped")):
        raise SystemExit("043 source suites must pass without failures, errors or skips")
if any(child.tag in ("failure", "error", "skipped") for case in cases for child in case):
    raise SystemExit("043 source testcase did not run and pass")
for name, count in sorted(actual.items()):
    print(f"043 source suite {name}: collected={count} passed={count} skipped=0 failures=0 errors=0")
PY
[ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]
cd "$original_tree"
git worktree remove "$feature_tree"
acceptance: Actual source CI execution passed. Custodian authentication and T010 gate acceptance remain independent and pending; all rollout gates retain their decisions.
